entities.name: Gan
entities.description: Once the largest city of Golthonor in ancient Corondor; its inhabitants were destroyed and it was renamed Ironhold.

entities.name: Golthonor
entities.description: Land on the continent of Corondor containing Gan.

entities.name: Trine
entities.description: Fallen angel who destroyed all the living Ganarians.

entities.name: Mandek Ironfist
entities.description: Warlord who ordered Gan's destruction, took over the city and founded the Iron Kingdom.

entities.name: Iron Kingdom
entities.description: Kingdom founded by Mandek centered on Gan, renamed Ironhold.

entities.name: Time of Legends
entities.description: Ancient era in which Gan was destroyed.

events.summary: The fallen angel Trine destroys all living Ganarians as ordered by Mandek Ironfist.
events.quote: all living 100,457 Ganarians were destroyed by the fallen angel Trine as ordered by warlord Mandek Ironfist

events.summary: Mandek takes over Gan, founds the Iron Kingdom and renames the city Ironhold.
events.quote: Mandek took over the city and founded the Iron Kingdom centered there, renaming the city itself Ironhold

relations.note: Trine destroyed all living Ganarians at Mandek's order.
relations.quote: all living 100,457 Ganarians were destroyed by the fallen angel Trine

relations.note: Acted as ordered by the warlord.
relations.quote: as ordered by warlord Mandek Ironfist
Mandek took over the city and founded the Iron Kingdom centered there

relations.note: Gan lay within Golthonor on Corondor.
relations.quote: it lay south of Wolf's Hackle , within the land of Golthonor on the continent of Corondor
